description: Look up the NovAI list price of a Chinese AI model by name fragment (seedance, kimi, glm, qwen, doubao, hunyuan, minimax...). Use this when the user asks what a specific model costs, or wants a price before choosing one. Returns the provider list price, the unit (per 1M tokens / per image / per generation) and the model id. Per-minute video costs with every row sourced: https://aiapi-pro.com/video-cost-2026
name: model_price
